nodes.meaning: Normalize the physical-momentum Berry/Kubo Hall prefactor.

nodes.statement:
∀ (e hbar m εF : ℝ),
  |m| ≤ εF →
    Filter.Tendsto (QuantumTheory.Transport.Models.MassiveDirac.intrinsicHallConductivityCutoff e hbar m εF)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (QuantumTheory.Transport.Models.MassiveDirac.intrinsicHallConductivity e hbar m εF))
nodes.meaning: Remove the UV cutoff from the occupation-derived intrinsic Hall conductivity.

nodes.statement:
∀ (e hbar m εF : ℝ),
  QuantumTheory.Transport.Models.MassiveDirac.intrinsicHallConductivity e hbar m εF =
    -(e ^ 2 / (2 * QuantumTheory.Transport.Models.MassiveDirac.planckFromReduced hbar)) * (m / εF)
nodes.meaning: Identify the clean intrinsic Hall conductivity with the massive-Dirac closed form.

nodes.statement:
∀ (e hbar m εF Λ : ℝ),
  QuantumTheory.Transport.Models.MassiveDirac.bastinCleanHallConductivityCutoff e hbar m εF Λ =
    QuantumTheory.Transport.Models.MassiveDirac.intrinsicHallConductivityCutoff e hbar m εF Λ
nodes.meaning: Match the finite-cutoff clean Bastin normalization to the intrinsic Hall normalization.

nodes.statement:
∀ (e hbar m εF : ℝ),
  |m| ≤ εF →
    Filter.Tendsto (QuantumTheory.Transport.Models.MassiveDirac.bastinCleanHallConductivityCutoff e hbar m εF)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (QuantumTheory.Transport.Models.MassiveDirac.intrinsicHallConductivity e hbar m εF))
nodes.meaning: Remove the UV cutoff from the normalized clean Bastin Hall conductivity.

nodes.statement:
∀ (e hbar m εF : ℝ),
  |m| ≤ εF →
    Filter.Tendsto (QuantumTheory.Transport.Models.MassiveDirac.bastinCleanHallConductivityCutoff e hbar m εF)
      Filter.atTop
      (nhds (-(e ^ 2 / (2 * QuantumTheory.Transport.Models.MassiveDirac.planckFromReduced hbar)) * (m / εF)))
nodes.meaning: Reach the closed massive-Dirac Hall benchmark from the clean Bastin route.
